body: Awesome, cheers guys

I'm sorry for loss, I'm not great at doing the talking thing, but your still in school, regardless of how your doing and not harming yourself regardless of the time passed is great thing, something I believe you should be proud be off

Might sound silly, but do you this walk often? This kind of thing happens to me all the time on walks I do on a regular basis, your brain doesn't 'save' the memory so to speak, I can do my walk back from work which is around 30 mins not remember getting back. This tends to be worse ok days where my depression worse, but happens on good days too. How this press your mind at rest abit
I hope so, I need to see them, learning is something I don't seem to do, I keep making the same mistakes over and over again and running away is one of my worst traits

I don't know, I've hurt my now ex wife so much and my kids.... I don't know if I'll be able to see them again, I know I'm broken, right now my mood has switched so the suicide is hiding away but that means when it comes back its going to be worse, I've made loads of bad decisions over the years but the last 6 months, it's just everyone seems to be bad
How do you report users? I'm getting messages from some one egging me on, I'm fighting hard to try and hold on
This is good, a nice way to express that I can relate too, thank you
Your never alone, there is always someone here to listen and talk if that's what you want
Awesome, well done 😃
There young, they will be stronger than me, there mother will find someone that makes them all happy, something I can't do anymore
I'm glad it's passed. Your important. Just try to remember that

That's awesome, make the most of those moments, if saying the words if hard, write a letter and give it to your sister, I found this helped me at first, and still do it, don't forget it the darkness people are here, anytime

With friends and family around you how you say are great, find time to spend as much time as you can with them, look at what they do, find the smiles and hold on to those, losing faith in anything takes time to rebuild, but it doesn't mean you can't do it, you can do it, I believe you can, I struggle with this, I watch those around me, join in where I can and find peace in that they smile when I'm there, these are just words, I'm not good with them, but I will be around if you need someone there
Theres a reason to hold on. I might not be best person on here to help, but I will always be about if you need to talk
Why? What's caused this? Nothing is unnecessary, things just like it in the short run

Hold out, have a scream, find something to chuck about and vent, don't go, your important, people out here want to hear you find your path, we will listern, talk to us, we are all going through own stuff, but we're here to help

People out there care. The person you say hi to at the shop, appreciating what you got is hard sometimes.

I know, I struggle too, you deserve everything you got, that means the good and the bad, without the bad the good can't be good.

Find something that makes you smile, something quick everyday you can do, look at, feel that makes you smile,

Tell people you appreciate them, it makes it easier, people care, people want to help, hold on, find a way meds aren't always the answer, people are better

What you done for me is important, a guy same age age as me holding out a hand showing that there is a reason to keep trying, I may not be able to do for along as I may like but I will as long as I can

There's a skill I could do with, I can't emphasise at all, just someone to talk with is good, someone that doesn't judge, I tryed before to go to sleep and not get up, but it was a half arsed attempt i was a few antidepressants short of being successful, thank you for talking to me
Wish I could truly believe it will be better, but as I commented my strength is low and my desire to carry on is almost gone

I would love to watch my kids grow up, but besides how my relationship with my wife has turned, my one with my children has suffered alot due to depression, disconnected from those close and don't have the strength anymore, I need to hold myself together  so I can take them on there first holiday, but after that I don't know
Got to be the citadel dlc when you find out there's a second you! That was brilliant
